report_title: ChatLaw Legal Corpus Expansion — Final Coverage Report
wording: ChatLaw currently covers selected Central Indian legislation across the following legal domains: criminal law, criminal procedure, evidence, contract, commercial/company, insolvency, property, tax/GST, environment, labour (partial), intellectual property, family/personal law (Hindu marriage), and consumer protection.
